By doing so, nations can harness the full potential of their diverse populations, ensuring a stronger, more resilient society.

In conclusion, the arguments in favor of discriminatory policies against Hispanic and Latino people are not only morally repugnant but also economically and socially shortsighted. True national interests lie in embracing diversity, promoting equality, and fostering an inclusive society where all communities can thrive.
